title: [H3] Human decision gate 3: Consolidate backlog and pull requests
body:
<!-- issue-734-triage:v1:start -->
## Reviewed backlog triage — #734

- Disposition: **verify**. Reconcile the historical claim against current contributor tooling and experiments code and evidence before proposing completion; unexecuted behavior remains unverified.
- Accountable ledger owner: **dhar174**; existing assignees preserved.
- Canonical topic: #14 (Contributor tooling and experiments); existing native parent preserved.
- Order: Phase 3; native prerequisites #737. Proposed execution prerequisites #732; handoff #738 (coordination, not an additional blocker).
- Acceptance/reproduction: Review every required task, current PR head, commands/results, and the phase-specific evidence.; Walk through the supported behavior, failure cases, and applicable design/engineering artifacts.; Choose exactly Approved, Changes requested, or Deferred; record reviewer, date, rationale, evidence, and issue-backed remediation.; Only close this gate after a human records Approved; keep rework/deferred gates open and downstream work blocked.; Do not auto-approve based on a passing suite, a bot action, elapsed time, or a completed checklist.; Human reviewer: dhar174, or a maintainer explicitly delegated in the Project.; Check prerequisite issues and the previous phase's recorded decision.; Review artifacts, current commit/PR heads, executed checks, known failures, and proposed scope.; Walk through the phase's success/failure scenarios and relevant design/engineering evidence.; Record reviewer, date, evidence links, rationale, and exactly one decision: Approved / Changes requested / Deferred.; Create a separate issue for each required remediation and add it as a blocker.; Set Project Decision to the human's recorded decision. Close this issue only after Approved.
- Evidence: #734's reviewed ledger and retained snapshot at `13b8e374d07e7e7ea6f8f562ea6a290fcab967f7`; outcome `existing_roadmap_or_remediation_acceptance_preserved`. Unexecuted behavior is not verified.
- Closure and gate boundary: No later human gate or broader product readiness is inferred.

- Publication approved under [D027](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/blob/eb3f1e2/docs/decisions.md#d027--approve-and-publish-the-734-backlog-triage-package); preserved source evidence remains scoped as above.

<!-- issue-734-triage:v1:end -->

<!-- tiny-village-roadmap:v1:H3:start -->
## Ordered delivery task H3

A human maintainer decides whether the phase satisfies its acceptance criteria and may unlock the next phase.

- Phase: 3 - Consolidate backlog and pull requests
- Sequence: 3900
- Priority: P1
- Scope: MVP
- Workstream: Review
- Kind: Phase gate
- Parent phase: [E3](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/733)

### Prerequisites

- [P3-01](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/734)
- [P3-02](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/735)
- [P3-03](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/736)
- [P3-04](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/737)
- [H2](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/732)

The preceding phase gate must be human-approved. Dependency closure alone does not supply a human decision.

### Acceptance criteria

- [x] Review every required task, current PR head, commands/results, and the phase-specific evidence.
- [x] Walk through the supported behavior, failure cases, and applicable design/engineering artifacts.
- [x] Choose exactly Approved, Changes requested, or Deferred; record reviewer, date, rationale, evidence, and issue-backed remediation.
- [x] Only close this gate after a human records Approved; keep rework/deferred gates open and downstream work blocked.
- [x] Do not auto-approve based on a passing suite, a bot action, elapsed time, or a completed checklist.

### Human decision step-through

- [x] Human reviewer: dhar174, or a maintainer explicitly delegated in the Project.
- [x] Check prerequisite issues and the previous phase's recorded decision.
- [x] Review artifacts, current commit/PR heads, executed checks, known failures, and proposed scope.
- [x] Walk through the phase's success/failure scenarios and relevant design/engineering evidence.
- [x] Record reviewer, date, evidence links, rationale, and exactly one decision: Approved / Changes requested / Deferred.
- [x] Create a separate issue for each required remediation and add it as a blocker.
- [ ] Set Project Decision to the human's recorded decision. Close this issue only after Approved.

Automation must not set Approved, infer approval from silence, or advance a downstream phase on elapsed time.

### Evidence to retain

Current commit/PR SHA; exact commands and executed result counts; relevant state traces/screens; review artifacts; limitations; linked follow-up issues.

<!-- tiny-village-roadmap:v1:H3:end -->


<!-- d034-phase3-gate-approval:start -->
## Explicit human decision: Approved

Human reviewer dhar174 replied **“I approve.”** on2026-11-02 America/New_York to the separate question about this scoped Phase3 work and retained follow-ups. [D034](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/blob/6890cde019ba93f748454ddfb4709b3fd8440e35/docs/decisions.md#d034--approve-phase-3-gate-738-with-retained-issue-backed-follow-ups) records the actual decision, rationale, evidence and limits. [Reviewed walkthrough](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/blob/6890cde019ba93f748454ddfb4709b3fd8440e35/docs/testing/phase-3-gate-walkthrough.md). This is an explicit human approval, not an inference from checks or elapsed time.

Canonical tasks #734–#737 and previous gate #732 are completed. The owner-authenticated final Project10 receipt verifies all332 managed rows/12 fields/six delivery views, exactly three approved final Readiness updates, zero pending writes and zero differences. The receipt remains point-in-time evidence atdc9fcc0. Merged evidence #813 is16528f2; fresh333 issue signatures/24 candidate heads/states match with only main advanced.

The approved scope explicitly retains the13 OPEN originalPhase3-tagged tickets #350/#352/#353/#357/#359/#501/#502/#503/#504/#643/#647/#651/#683 and runtime requirements #799–#803/#741/#773/#774/#807–#809. Existing bodies, parents, assignments and dependency edges remain intact; no runtime failure, future PR integration or later gate is marked complete. No new required gate remediation was identified; retained requirements already have their own issues. Both headless/Pygame and final-product AI remain required under D013–D015.

Close #738 as completed under this explicit Approved decision. Parent #733 follows only after all five native phase children are completed. This unlocks ordered Phase4 work; no runtime implementation is performed by this closeout.

**Project synchronization remains pending:** current cloud read returns FORBIDDEN. The last human step-through checkbox stays unchecked because Project DecisionApproved/ReadinessTracking and downstream readiness still need the owner-authenticated publication route and independent readback. The issue decision is authoritative; no live Project write is claimed here.
<!-- d034-phase3-gate-approval:end -->
